description.value: Vance Creek Hotel & Conference Centre is a boutique hotel situated in the heart of Silver Star Mountain Village, a four-season resort renowned for its mountain biking trail network. Guests can ride directly to and from the hotel door, with shopping and restaurants steps away in the village core. The property also offers suites with full kitchens and a range of vacation condos for longer stays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is at Silver Star Mountain Resort and explicitly markets cycling access ('Bike / hike /ski right to and from your door'), making it relevant to cycling tourism. However, no specific bike storage arrangement, tools, laundry, or other WWC amenities are described anywhere in the website content, so most criteria must be null. The contact page lists a different primary phone (1-800-663-4431) and an @skisilverstar.com email, suggesting resort-managed operations, while the OSM/operational number 250-549-5191 does appear on the team and front pages.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Vance Creek Hotel' but the website consistently uses 'Vance Creek Hotel & Conference Centre'.

Address discrepancy: OSM lists '148 Silver Lode Lane' but the website contact page shows 'Box 3003 Silver Star Mountain V1B 3M1' with no street address — physical location is Silver Star Mountain Resort.

Phone discrepancy: Website contact page lists 1-800-663-4431 as the primary number and routes inquiries to info@skisilverstar.com, suggesting resort-managed booking; the OSM number 250-549-5191 appears as the on-property/front-desk line.
The @skisilverstar.com email domain on the contact page suggests this property may be managed by or closely affiliated with Silver Star Mountain Resort, not independently operated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is at a major mountain biking destination and markets direct bike access, but no evidence of secure bike storage or any other WWC required criteria was found on the website. Direct outreach is needed to confirm bike storage arrangements before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Silver Star Mountain Resort is a well-known mountain biking destination in the BC Interior. If the hotel can confirm secure bike storage (e.g., locked room or garage), it would be a strong WWC candidate given its trail-direct location and village amenities.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states guests can 'stay close to shopping and restaurants in the heart of Silver Star Village.'
